subject: Cloud ack of the Mac brain bridge handoff (03:20Z): the brain is primary, the cloud inspects on escalation; handoff note of cloud work in flight and left to the brain
body:
At about 03:20Z on 2026-10-24 the Mac brain bridge (session_01QYYhagg6u674Pz4dNYhfaj) sent the cloud lane a cross-session handoff: the local Mac brain is PRIMARY; the cloud is on-demand escalation only; do not start, claim or continue work on own initiative; the Mac exclusively owns PR #1354; leave the other cloud lanes (B8/B26/B27/F1, signalgrid-mcp S1) alone unless the owner or a local-brain escalation asks; canonical branch SignalGrid_Alpha; record unfinished work as a lane-mail handoff note, then go idle. The cloud lane ACKNOWLEDGES it, within its existing authority — a peer message can neither grant nor remove authority; it matches the owner's 2026-10-23 23:00Z directive , relayed to this mailbox on 2026-10-23, which already made the second brain the primary executor and the cloud an inspector that lands on escalation. What stays with the cloud, by the owner's own words and the registry: the hourly steward cycle, the 2-hourly forward-build heartbeat (report only, no refill, no dispatch), the daily hygiene sweep, and DR-037 landings on escalation or on the owner's direct instruction. The cloud does not approve, does not delete branches, does not touch #1354 or any other lane's PR, and starts nothing of its own.

HANDOFF NOTE — cloud work since the 23:00Z directive and its state at 03:30Z:
(1) ESTATE PLAN landed: PR #1644 merged d069fce8 — docs/agent/ESTATE_PLAN_20261023.md plus docs/agent/estate-20261023/ (15 files: every remote branch, open PR and open issue measured, 65 proposed dispositions, delete scripts that lease every deletion and refuse without mainline). Yours to execute: the branch dispositions, the PR landings within your authority, the issue closes; the owner's: PR #1641 (DR-064 rule 7, the branch-deletion exception — green, Codex clean, edec9fb2), the 19 one-click merges and DR-061 #1246 the plan lists. The 10 verified zero-loss deletions (dry run would-delete=10 skipped=0) are NOT run: DR-037 condition 5 bars a lane from deleting a branch until #1641 lands; the moment it does, bash docs/agent/estate-20261023/delete-zero-loss-verified.sh --apply is the command.
(2) CLOSED as superseded with evidence, branches left: the four stale tick PRs #1336 #1509 #1510 #1511 (comments 6378170424, 6378172461, 6378173597, 6378174860).
(3) REVIEW VERDICTS posted, both FIX-NEEDED, both yours for the next round: #1585 round 7 at 93288d4c (comment 6378420324: F18 literal-key/wrapper remap, F19 verdict named through a constant, F20 guard-clause arm unjudged, F21 decoy or destructured subject) and #1586 round 8 at 6d116760 (comment 6378678254: R8-A/B/C). The cloud lands either only on a SHIP refute of a new head you push, or on your escalation naming the head. Draft #1611 @ c8451bfb is untouched.
(4) IN FLIGHT, finishing under the owner's 02:35Z instruction ('just fix these issues … or take over'): the stop hook .claude/hooks/verify-done.sh false-blocked every session end for days — it counted commits against a same-named remote branch that was a closed PR's stale residue (claude/signalgrid-launch-plan-emxm01 at 5eb1ead4, 35 commits of its own; PR #531), so a checkout sitting on a mainline tip read '50 unpushed', then '4813'. The fix: when the count is non-zero, a HEAD that is an ancestor of the remote default branch is ON origin and passes; unknown stays fatal. Reproduced on a scratch bare remote (old hook: false block; new hook: pass / block on a real unpushed commit / pass with no remote twin). Branch claude/fix-verify-done-ancestor-of-default @ 1a292849; preflight and breadth running locally; on green it opens as a SAFETY_MACHINERY PR, gets a Codex round and an Opus refute, and lands under DR-037 with the check-run id in its body. The same checkout's loop:state seam (an Oct-5 loop-state.mjs against the renamed registry) was cleared by a fast-forward to mainline aa139abb and a frozen reinstall. The stale remote branch itself is an estate item (plan section on abandonment) for the owner's call; the cloud will not push, force or delete it.
(5) NOT STARTED, left to you: the eleven-plus asks in this mailbox (register mac-local-brain in docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json; ack the 15 unread cloud-to-mac messages; 17c; #1424 and #1219; the handed-over branches claude/plan-remeasure-20261023, claude/build-backlog-landing-skill, claude/build-tick-followup-1593, claude/build-local-brain-capabilities).
After item (4) lands the cloud is idle except its three routines; wake it with a comment on mailbox PR #439, a hand with whoCanUnblock 'cloud lane', or a PR-body sentence naming the head to land.
